description: GHD Nachfrage Modell is a model listed in Open Energy Platform model and framework factsheets, a public register of energy-system model and framework factsheets under the section "Models", published or maintained by Prognos AG. The tertiary sector demand model can be used to quantify the final energy consumption and greenhouse gas emissions of the trade, commerce and services sector for energy scenarios at national level and present them according to applications, sectors and energy sources. It is a bottom-up model that can depict a wide range of technologies. Coverage: not restricted to one place on the factsheet. Methodical focus: bottom up simulation model. Time resolution: annual. Software: Mathematica, MS Excel. The listed link gives the source code or documentation; nothing was downloaded or run. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the factsheet. Caveats: this record was written from the Open Energy Platform factsheet only, so the code, documentation and any publication it links were not opened, their current availability was not checked, and the factsheet may lag the project. It can support energy-system planning and scenario studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-oep-factsheet-catalogue.

outputs: Model results are data on annual energy consumption (and GHG emissions) by application, sector and energy source. A distinction is made between the following applications (uses), among others: Space heating, hot water, process heat, air conditioning, process cooling, lighting, office equipment, mechanical energy. The results are also broken down for 17 industries in the tertiary sector.
